purpose: Post-detection descriptive all-epoch comparison of64 previously unresolved events, including main exposures without saved V2 hits. No new detection or final origin classifier.
grouping: Sort per target by barycentric wavelength then ID; greedy groups with maximum span0.10Å from the first member; center=median member wavelength; topocentric center anchored to earliest review ID member.

sampling.interpolation: Linear, only within existing coverage; preserve NaN/gap flags; no extrapolation.
sampling.normalization: Median of original flux within±2Å of each frame-specific barycentric center, positive finite denominator required. This is a local relative profile, not continuum-normalized physical line flux.
sampling.linear_background: Fit line using fixed outer offsets |x|=0.60..1.00Å; subtract for shape correlation.
sampling.reference_comparison: Median Pearson correlation of all epoch pairs at zero shift; per-epoch correlation against leave-one-out median residual profile. No center/width/shift optimized to maximize correlation.
sampling.line_measure: Independent unweighted fits of constant+linear slope+positive-or-negative unit-height Gaussian at fixed center, FWHM λ/115000 and three times this width, using |offset|<=0.25Å. Signed amplitudes retained; not detection SNR.
sampling.uncertainty: ERR field availability checked. No formal amplitude errors if absent. Robust first-difference MAD/sqrt2 is only a local noise proxy because resampling correlations and spectral structure remain. Report epoch amplitude median/IQR/range and correlation ranges, not confidence intervals.
sampling.low_reference_continuum: Flag local flux normalization median <=3 times first-difference noise proxy; do not exclude silently.

frame_transform: λ_top≈λ_bary/(1+BERV/c), c299792.458km/s. Classical approximation, not a validated full HARPS drift/relativistic or stellar-rest-frame correction. No fixed stellar radial velocity assumed.
interpretation: Greater barycentric similarity is descriptive consistency with persistent source-associated spectral structure, not proof of natural emission, rest wavelength identity, or absence of technology. Source selection on known hits and group centers is explicitly post hoc.
